You have a home in mind.
Let’s make sense of the cost.

You can picture living there. Now you need to know how the numbers fit your life. Start with the mortgage and ongoing costs, then compare the offers and prices you’re considering before you decide.

1. Estimate the monthly cost

What could this home
cost each month?

Start with the price, down payment, rate and loan term. Add property taxes, homeowners insurance and other expenses, including mortgage insurance or HOA fees if they apply. See a monthly estimate based on the costs you enter.

2. Compare your options

Another offer. A new price.
See the difference.

A lender quotes a different rate. The seller considers a lower price. Compare up to three plans side by side to see what changes in the monthly payment, interest and total cost. Keep expense estimates consistent when comparing lenders.

3. Keep the details together

The home. The offers.
One place to come back to.

Keep the home price, lender terms, notes and photos with your saved plans. Update the numbers as the conversation moves forward, then return to the options you want to discuss. Less to remember when it’s time to decide.

A few things to know first.

Is Bricks Calc free?

Yes. Save up to three plans for free, with free iCloud sync. Pro adds Shared Costs and unlimited saved plans, extra payments and expenses.

Can I compare offers for the same home?

Yes. Compare up to three plans with different rates, down payments or loan terms. You can also try a different purchase price. Keep tax and insurance estimates consistent, and check lender fees and cash to close on each Loan Estimate.

Do I need an account or internet connection?

No account is required, and calculations work offline. iCloud sync is free and uses your iCloud account and an internet connection to keep saved plans across your Apple devices.

What belongs in my monthly estimate?

Include principal and interest, property taxes, homeowners insurance and, if applicable, mortgage insurance and HOA fees. Budget separately for utilities, maintenance and upfront closing costs.

Can I rely on this as a lender quote?

No. Bricks Calc provides planning estimates based on your inputs and fixed-rate assumptions. Your lender confirms eligibility, loan terms, fees and final payments. Taxes, insurance and other expenses can change.

Which devices are supported?

Bricks Calc is available on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro.
